params.body:
Behind the login everyone saw everything, and a login could only be made on the server. To let the people working on the handover in under their own name (instead of on a shared link), or to let someone in the office in, somebody had to open a database.

## Roles

| Role | Opens |
|---|---|
| Beheerder (admin) | everything, and Gebruikers |
| Kantoor | everything but Gebruikers |
| Overdracht | Verkennen, Netwerk and Overdracht: the pages a shared link opens, under its own name |

- **Existing users.** Everyone who had a login becomes admin in the migration, so nobody loses a page they had. A user made in code defaults to Kantoor.
- **Overdracht.** A login with this role is sent to Verkennen when it asks for an office page, and sees only its three pages in the menu.
- **Deactivating.** A switched-off user cannot log in (the same message as a wrong password), and one who is signed in is signed out at the next request.

## Gebruikers (`/gebruikers`, admins only)

- **Add a user.** Name, email and role. The page shows a one-time link, valid for 7 days, where the new user sets their own password (at least 12 characters) and is signed in. Only the link's hash is stored, and it is shown once. Nothing depends on mail arriving: the admin passes the link on.
- **Change a role** in the list.
- **"Nieuwe link"** for a forgotten password.
- **"Uitschakelen" / "Inschakelen".** Switching off also voids an open link.
- **The last active admin** cannot be demoted or switched off.
- **Status per user:** active, link open until a date, or switched off.

## Code

- Migration: `users.role`, `active`, `invite_hash`, `invite_expires_at`.
- `User`: `ROLES`, `isAdmin()`, `seesOffice()`, `invite()`, `invited()`.
- Middleware:
  - `OfficeOnly` on the office group;
  - `AdminOnly` on Gebruikers;
  - `OfficeOrExploreLink` now also checks that the user is active.

  All three are persistent for Livewire requests. `Users` also checks admin in `boot()`.
- Login refuses inactive users and lands an Overdracht login on Verkennen.
- `Welcome` at `/welkom/{token}` (throttled).

## Tests

`UserAdminTest` covers:
- an admin adds a user, the link sets the password once, and the user lands on Verkennen;
- the roles open and close the right pages;
- a switched-off user cannot log in and is out at once;
- the last admin stays, and a Kantoor user cannot open Gebruikers;
- a used or unknown link says so.

Full suite 281/281. Walked through in headless Chromium: add Ellen as Overdracht, open her link in a fresh browser, set a password; she lands on Verkennen with only its three pages in the menu.

After merge: `php artisan migrate` (existing logins become admin).
